ProjectName: Hr - Saavy Stract Custom App in Python [Astoundz]
description:
This project is to build web app in Python which have features to grab the required data from uploaded multiple documents and map with the text and image from our database and generate final document in PDF as per template we set.


Two different interfaces:

1. System Admin

2. End-User (i.e. Law Firm)


System Admin Interface:


  • Dashboard: It will show the total no. of generated documents, the total no. of end users (Law Firms), and a list of the latest 10 generated documents.


  • Document template management insurance/attorney company-wise (Enable/Disable option)


  • Document management module which has the option to view the document


  • End-User(Law Firm) Management (Add/View/Edit/Delete/Block/Approve/Reject options)


  • System admin user Role Management

  • System admin user Management


End-User(Law Firm) Interface:


  • Dashboard (No. of document created, table of recently created 10 documents)


  • Document Management


  • Create Document

  • Select Template


  • Upload document



  • Preview/edit generated document based on selected template which will have a save and download button, once clicked on it a PDF of the document will be generated



  • Listing of generated documents that have the option to download again.


  • Profile Management (Edit/Update)


  • Change Password.


  • There will be a landing page of the website that will have the option to log in or Register, If a new user registers, then the admin will get their request and once the admin has approved, the new user will be able to generate documents only.


Note: This is for one document template only. (It will take additional development time to set up a new document template.)


- Database creation

- Static screen development other development like login/signup/user management/document management, role management

- OCR and checking of fetched texts

- Mapping for a single document

- Image recognition using OpenCV

description:
Project Title: Designer needed to convert print material templates created in Figma into InDesign files.

Tracker: Vasu Bhut

Due Date: 6/6/2023


This is a long-term project where we need to convert the Figma file to Indesign. We need to strictly follow the client's instructions given below and there are no mistakes acceptable in creating folders, structuring files, converting Figma to Indesign etc...


We would like to convert the following Figma designs to InDesign documents: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1yi7sS1MeNi-w8s2m2WuPXtdVgQjevVegbxbZnbTs2rw/edit#gid=0


Please note, there will be several batches of designs to be converted (roughly 60 to be expected in total throughout the month of June). The link to the spreadsheet contains just those in the first batch, and I will be updating the spreadsheet once we’ve gone through the initial review process with additional batches of designs to be converted.


There are 29 InDesign documents to create for this first batch. Each InDesign document should consist of 2 Pages. There is one Figma link in the spreadsheet, and this one Figma link contains all 29 different InDesign documents to be created.


As per the previous batch you have done with Charly, for each InDesign document, there should be 2 top level Layer Folders called Editable and Background to be created, with Editable listed first / at the top. Do not create any sub-folders within each.


The spreadsheet notes in column G which layers should go into the editable folder, and column H what should go in the Background folder (basically everything else). I have also attached screenshots of an example design with indicators (red rectangles) on what should be editable within each InDesign document.


Each Text Layer must be called with the start of the text value they contain. No < > must be present in layer names in InDesign.


Each Image or Shape layer should be called in InDesign the same as they are called in Figma if the name is explicit, otherwise, name it in a way that describe clearly what the layer is or does. For images, the filename and the extension should preferably be used.


Images should be converted to EPS format.


Icons and Logos are to be converted to EPS format (if to be replaceable)


The Font files are attached. I’ve also indicated on the spreadsheet (Column F) which template uses which fonts, as there are some language designs that use different fonts than others. The font and styles used will need to be reflected accurately in InDesign (e.g. line height, size, spacing...).


Each InDesign document can be provided as a Folder/Package with all the files within it, or as a standalone document with the content embedded as you did previously.


Please also take into consideration that adjustments done during the last batch done previously with Charly to ensure colors, fonts, etc, are as accurately represented as possible in the converted InDesign version of the Figma design.

description:
Project Overview and Goals:

Redesign the website for Wareham Chiropractic Clinic to create a modern, professional, and friendly online presence that evokes trust and appeals to the local community. The new design should improve user experience, enhance visual appeal, and effectively communicate the clinic's services and values. Key design goals include a clean, polished look, a simplified user-friendly navigation, and a fully responsive design for all devices.


Key Pages and Elements:

Design the following pages: Home, About Us, Services, Testimonials, Contact Us, and Blog. The home page should feature a hero section with a compelling headline, a brief introduction, an overview of services, patient testimonials, and clear calls to action (e.g., "Book an Appointment"). The design should use a cohesive color scheme (calm blues and greens with warm accents), modern typography, and high-quality images. Each page should have a consistent header with navigation, and the footer should include contact information and social media links. The overall layout should be clean and spacious, with ample white space and a grid system for consistency.

Requirement: Client is looking for a website development service to create a site for his home, which includes four rooms available for booking, a party room for special events, and general information about the house and surrounding community.
Here are the key features I am seeking:
- Room Booking System: Guests should be able to book one of our four rooms and check availability.
- Party Room Reservation: We need a separate section where guests can reserve our party room for events, with the ability to view availability and book online.

- House and Community Information: I would like to include a section with information about the property, amenities, house rules, and details about the local area (restaurants, attractions, etc.).

Here is some insights about home/rooms and flow of booking,

items.content: This is intended for friends or family who wish to stay with us, so this won't be on Airbnb. We only want the availability to book from our website.
We want the process to be one in which anyone can book a room with check-in and check-out at any time they wish.

After they submit their booking, they'll be notified that they'll get a notification after their booking is confirmed. The admin will have to confirm the booking, and the admin will assign one of the four rooms.
We want information on the confirmation booking on how they can enter the house and where their room is located.
Each room will be numbered and have its own theme. The themes are Forest, Mountain, Ocean, and Desert, so for example, the room will be called: 'Room #1, The Mountain Room'.

data.text: For payment,

For the party room, which we call 'The Simcha Hall,' we only want a $250 deposit to be held for damages, and this will be returned three days after the booking is over.
We have to use PayPal
